title: Can I BEAT Petrified Pawns?
summary: Petrified Pawns (indie game 'where chess meets monsters and magic'): a 3D dungeon crawler where you escort your King through rooms (reportedly 18 levels), commanding chess-piece units that move with chess patterns and auto-attack nearby enemies in their attack pattern. Smash boxes/vases for mana, cast spells (Lesser Heal +800 HP), collect keys/items from chests, recruit a new piece after each level (bishop, rook with mana discount, pawn with fortunate trait). He clears early levels but loses the rook and stalls on a later level.
rules: Select a piece with left click, move with right click (real-time-ish dungeon movement on a grid).
Units have health bars (e.g. king, rook 300, queen 2000 HP); enemies have red health bars.

Attack enemies by standing close to them in your piece's attack pattern (rook attacks orthogonally adjacent/in line; pawn attacks diagonally; knight at L-distance); being in an enemy's pattern makes you take damage.
Boxes and vases give mana (blue bar); spells cost mana: Lesser Heal (instantly heals a friendly unit 800 HP), chain heal (bounces to up to 5 units ~700 HP), potions in inventory.
Mission each level: escort your King to the exit; if the King dies, restart the level. Locked doors need keys from chests.
Level reward: pick a new chess piece with a trait (Rook: mana discount -1 on all abilities; Pawn: first move double range, attacks diagonally, Fortunate +2% critical heal; Bishop: diagonal).
Only a couple of pieces can be released at a time; enemy queen flees from close opponents; trait 'anti' deals +100% damage to bishops on 40% of attacks.
win_condition: Escort the King to the end of each level (complete all levels).
